facts: More than 8.8 million people (2024), a third of Angola's population
Angola's chief seaport, on its northern Atlantic coast
worth_knowing: Founded in January 1576 as São Paulo da Assunção de Loanda by the Portuguese explorer Paulo Dias de Novais. It is the most populous Portuguese-speaking national capital in the world.
